description: FDA GUDID device record by Device Identifier (DI, the GS1/GUDID number on a device label): brand, company, model, description, GMDN term, MRI safety status, single-use and prescription flags. From openFDA's GUDID copy, with FDA AccessGUDID as fallback. Lookup by DI only; no name search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
